from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Company(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if provided in the document")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating revenue for the period in Yuan")
    roe: float | None = Field(description="Weighted average return on net assets in percent for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[Company]
